const {registerTopic} = require('./solution');
require('node:assert').throws(() => registerTopic([{label:' x ',createdIndex:0,purpose:'discussion'}], 'x', 1), RangeError);

prompt.text:
Implement two immutable state helpers: `registerTopic(catalog, label, createdIndex)` and `leaveTopic(session)`.

A catalog is an array of records shaped `{ label, createdIndex, purpose }`. `registerTopic` requires a non-empty trimmed string `label` and a non-negative safe-integer `createdIndex`. Existing catalog entries must have the same valid shape, and labels must be unique. It appends `{ label: label.trim(), createdIndex, purpose: "discussion" }`; a duplicate trimmed label throws `RangeError`. Preserve existing order.

A session must be an object containing own properties `member` and `topic`. `leaveTopic` returns a new shallow copy with those two properties set to `null`, preserving all other properties.

Malformed arguments throw `TypeError`. Neither function may mutate its input. Returned arrays, entries, and session objects must not alias mutable containers created by the functions; existing catalog entries must also be shallow-copied. An empty catalog is valid.

Use CommonJS and export exactly `{ registerTopic, leaveTopic }`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
